title: int:MarketTimeSeries
description: Header record for a historical market time-series dataset provided by TUM for FOS optimisation.

communityId.description: FK to Community. IRI: int:communityId. UUID v4.

marketIds.description: List of market IDs recorded in this time series. IRI: int:marketIds. UUID v4 array.

periodFrom.description: Start of the historical data period. IRI: int:periodFrom. ISO 8601 with timezone. Must be < periodUntil.

periodUntil.description: End of the historical data period. IRI: int:periodUntil. ISO 8601 with timezone.

granularity.description: Time resolution of child records. IRI: int:granularity.
